spec.path_form: bare; /api/v1 lives in servers:, with a .../json server entry for the test suite

client.archive_digest_not_used: Jellyfin's archive re-compresses server-side and returned two hashes for one pinned URL

presence.note: Jellyfin reached 83.0% on the verbatim test alone; Zulip concatenates parameterised paths so the {param} form is never literal

repaired.mechanism: Zulip wraps jQuery in its own channel module, so URL literals sit beside channel.post( rather than fetch(/axios/$.ajax; only 28 of 250 relative rows acquired request-construction evidence

no_strip_comparison.note: the strip decides the result, which is why it was fixed in advance

verdict: partially generalized (unchanged); secondary missed by 13.3 pts not 14.5

criterion.primary: repaired recall reaches >= 90% of the measured extraction ceiling
criterion.note: A ceiling-relative primary is the correct form: an absolute point-gain requirement would be imposed on a quantity bounded by a ceiling that differs per application.

tier.definition: request-construction precision minus absent-evidence precision, assigned by classifier_rule.classify_endpoint over every relative-path record in the extraction
tier.bar: +20 points for the tier to be said to carry signal

excluded_on_purpose: starlight_help/dist/** - documentation site, not the app client
zerver/openapi/javascript_examples.js - derived from the specification itself; including it would inflate the join by construction
